main.description: The extended (long-form) profile behind /themself. A singleton at at://{me}/is.dame.profile/self. The Bluesky app.bsky.actor.profile record holds the SHORT version — avatar, display name, 256-char description — and /themself renders that card above this record's long-form body. The `show*` flags decide how much of that Bluesky card appears, so the long-form can stand on its own once it says things better.

tagline.description: One line under the name. Doubles as the page heading when `showIdentity` is false, and as the /themself OG description (see og/pageContent.js).

photos.description: Portrait gallery shown between the identity card and the long-form body. Laid out by `photoLayout`.

photoLayout.description: How `photos` are laid out. Same vocabulary as the image-block galleries in a leaflet body (LeafletDocument's GALLERY_LAYOUTS), so a photo strip here and a photo strip mid-essay are the same shape. Column counts hold at every width.

content.description: The long-form body as pub.leaflet.content — the same block editor and renderer site.standard.document uses, so the bio can carry inline images, headers, lists, code and embedded Bluesky posts. Takes precedence over `body` when both are present.

body.description: Long-form body as plain markdown. The original shape, kept as a fallback: rendered only when `content` has no blocks.

bodyFormat.description: How to render `body`. Ignored when `content` is present.

links.description: Labelled external links shown under the identity card.

showAvatar.description: Show the Bluesky avatar. Absent reads as true.

showIdentity.description: Show the Bluesky display name and handle. Absent reads as true. When false the tagline becomes the page heading, so the page is never left without one.

showBlueskyBio.description: Show the Bluesky profile description (the short bio). Absent reads as true. Turn off once the long-form body says it better.

aspectRatio.description: Intrinsic pixel dimensions, sniffed at upload time so the layout can reserve the box before the file arrives.
